# Mireside Peat Works - turf cutting, May 2026

One row per block cut; turf_count is the number of turfs lifted from that block.

turns.prompt: Mireside Peat Works pays a bog restoration levy of 1.85 pounds for every turf lifted. What levy is due on the turfs lifted from the blocks cut in May 2026? Give the amount as a number of pounds and pence. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
